data.one_liner: Flutter package to add hover actions and enhancements to cards.
data.what_it_does: It lets developers wrap their cards in a CardActions widget to provide customizable action buttons that appear on hover. It supports configurable dimensions, directions, background colors, cursors, and tooltips.
use_when: You want to add hover-triggered action buttons to desktop or web cards
You need customizable tooltips and cursors for card action buttons
avoid_when: You need mobile device support immediately, as it is not yet fully optimized or supported for mobile touch interactions
You require complex state management solutions
strengths: Great customization options for cursors, background colors, and axis directions
weaknesses: Not yet usable on mobile devices out of the box
data.minimal_example:
CardActions(
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    actions: <CardActionButton>[
        CardActionButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.edit, color: Colors.white),
            label: 'edit',
            press: () {},
        ),
    ],
    child: YourCard(),
)
